rounds.text: Prime Securities Ltd demonstrates exceptional structural efficiency, boasting a Return on Assets (ROA) of 2.01% that strongly outperforms the sector benchmark of -0.46% [E8]. The long-term top-line expansion is robust, underscored by a compounded sales growth rate of 19% over 10 years and an accelerating 23% over 3 years [E14, E16]. This operational momentum is directly translating into bottom-line outperformance, supported by a solid 21.7% CAGR in profit growth over the last 5 years [E60]. Furthermore, recent fundamentals-led signals show that profit growth exceeds one-year price growth by 9%, indicating that the company is beginning to outperform expectations while trading in the lower half of its 52-week range [E1, E5, E57]. Conceded: the trailing twelve months show a compounded sales contraction of -7% and a near-term P/E ratio reaching 200.72x against the sector benchmark of 33.23x [E6, E17].
